# Fixture corpus — generated by the v1 sidecar, committed

Status: complete

## Parent

`.scratch/v2-single-binary/PRD.md` (step 2). Decision record: ADR-0028 (the matrix),
testing strategy in the PRD.

## What to build

A one-shot generation script plus the committed corpus it produces. The script runs the
**v1 sidecar ffmpeg** (populate via `npm run fetch:ffmpeg` if `src-tauri/binaries/` is
empty) — this is the old sidecar's last service and must happen **before** the sidecar
machinery is retired (issue 06).

Fixtures: ~1 second, 64×64, silent-tone audio, a few KB each, committed directly under a
test-fixtures directory. One per real-world (demuxer × video codec × audio codec) cell of
the ADR-0028 matrix, per the PRD list:

- h264+aac/mp4 · hevc+aac/mp4 · hevc+aac/mkv · av1+opus/mp4 (libaom or svt-av1 from the
  old sidecar) · vp9+opus/webm · vp8+vorbis/webm · mpeg4+mp3/avi · msmpeg4v3+wmav2/asf ·
  wmv2+wmav2/asf · mpeg2+mp2/ts · mpeg2+ac3/vob (mpegps) · mpeg1 (mpegvideo) ·
  prores+pcm_s16le/mov · dnxhd/mxf · mjpeg+pcm/avi · theora+vorbis/mkv · h263/3gp ·
  flv1+mp3/flv · plus audio-codec variants covering flac, alac, eac3 in containers from
  the matrix
- a **rotated** h264/mp4 (display-matrix side data, e.g. rotate=90) — drives the
  autorotation assertion later
- an **extensionless** copy of one valid fixture — drives the ADR-0011 fallback path

**Known un-generatable cells:** FFmpeg has no `vc1`/`wmv3` and no `wmapro` encoder. Record
these as an explicit allowlisted-gap list (a small committed file the future drift test
reads), so the gap is documented, not forgotten.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Every demuxer and decoder in the ADR-0028 matrix is covered by ≥1 fixture **or** an
      entry in the committed allowlisted-gap file (only `vc1`, `wmapro` expected there)
- [x] Corpus includes the rotated fixture and the extensionless fixture
- [x] Every generated fixture probes successfully with the current (sidecar) `probe.rs`
      path — i.e. v1 itself could convert them
- [x] Total corpus size stays in the low hundreds of KB; fixtures are committed directly
      (no LFS)
- [x] The generation script is committed, idempotent (re-run overwrites cleanly), and
      clearly marked as one-shot tooling that depends on the v1 sidecar
- [x] `cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml` still green (no behavior change)

## Blocked by

None — can start immediately.

## Notes

- 64×64 is even-dimensioned by design (yuv420p-safe); keep it that way.
- h263 has constrained legal frame sizes — use 128×96 for that one fixture if 64×64 is
  rejected.
- Naming convention suggestion: `<vcodec>-<acodec>.<container>` (e.g. `hevc-aac.mkv`) so
  the future drift test (issue 05) can parse coverage from filenames.

## Comments

**2026-06-10 (agent, on completion):** Implemented as `scripts/generate-fixtures.mjs`
(`npm run fixtures:generate`), corpus committed under `src-tauri/tests/fixtures/`
(32 files, 525.6 KiB) plus `allowlisted-gaps.json` (`vc1`, `wmapro`). Decisions made
while implementing:

- The acceptance criterion "every decoder covered" goes beyond the PRD's named list, so
  fixtures for `msmpeg4v2`, `wmv1`, and the full PCM family (`s16be`, `s24le`, `s32le`,
  `u8`, `f32le`, `alaw`, `mulaw`) were added beyond the PRD bullet. PCM tracks use
  8000 Hz mono to keep uncompressed audio within the size budget.
- Filenames use **ffprobe `codec_name` spellings** (`mpeg2video-mp2.ts`, not `mpeg2`;
  `flv1-mp3.flv`); video-only fixtures omit the acodec segment (`mpeg1video.m1v`,
  `dnxhd.mxf`). The script verifies filename↔content agreement, so issue 05 can trust
  the names.
- `dnxhd.mxf` is DNxHR LB (resolution-flexible profile) at its 256×120 minimum, 5 fps —
  the mxf muxer needs `-strict unofficial` for that rate; the demuxer reads it fine.
- The rotated fixture is a `-display_rotation 90` stream-copy remux of `h264-aac.mp4`,
  so the rotation is guaranteed to be display-matrix side data (script asserts ±90 via
  ffprobe), never baked-in pixels. Extensionless fixture: `h264-aac-noext`.
- New integration test `src-tauri/tests/fixtures_probe.rs` probes every committed
  fixture through the real `probe.rs` path (skip-guarded like `smoke.rs`); full
  `cargo test` green (40 tests).
